What the results show

    Association is not causation. Cramér's V measures how strongly a factor and loss-making move together, not direction or cause, and drivers overlap (for example, discounting practices differ by state and product). The static V chart describes the full dataset; the discount-band and sub-category charts and the text above respond to the filters.

    Sub-category × region: profit margin

    Cell = profit margin and sales. Blue = profit, orange = loss, white = break-even.

    Sub-categories: discount vs profit margin

    Bubble size = sales. Dashed line = company margin, solid line = break-even.

    Performance table

    Share of all profit uses total company profit as the base, regardless of filters.
